title: Miami Beach police dispute viral cyclist video
finding: Axios reports a stationary Waymo awaiting pickup had no contact with a cyclist hit by a separate car. The SGO entry describes a moving Waymo and a bicycle collision. The month and city overlap, but the descriptions do not establish that this article covers the SGO incident. Do not merge them or claim the SGO report was disproved.

title: North Phoenix pub fight with Waymo damage
finding: The critical injury followed a fight outside a Phoenix pub; a Waymo was damaged in the parking lot. The story does not describe a traffic collision and does not match the Scottsdale June SGO report.
